policy.classificationRequirement: Every accepted finding has category, disposition, owner, and rationale.

large-class.rationale: Reported classes are cohesive stores, runners, or protocol facades with explicit authority boundaries.

long-parameter-list.rationale: Reported signatures are explicit protocol or callback contracts; object wrapping would obscure established boundaries.

nested-ternary.rationale: Nested expressions are bounded projection assembly and remain covered by tests.

nested-ternary-js.rationale: Nested expressions are controlled test-fixture assembly.

no-array-reverse-mutation.rationale: Every finding reverses a spread/slice copy or a consumed local disposer list, not shared authoritative state.

no-array-reverse-mutation-js.rationale: Every finding reverses a fresh test-fixture array copy, not shared authoritative state.

no-await-expression-member.rationale: Parenthesized await-member access is correct; removing parentheses would read from an unresolved Promise.

no-await-expression-member-js.rationale: Parenthesized await-member access is correct; removing parentheses would read from an unresolved Promise.

no-bare-object-param.rationale: Parameters require named interfaces or exact unknown-valued records.

no-conditional-empty-object-spread.rationale: Conditional spreads deliberately preserve canonical omission semantics instead of materializing undefined fields.

no-conditional-empty-object-spread-js.rationale: Controlled JavaScript fixtures use the same canonical optional-field omission idiom.

no-dupe-keys-js.rationale: Duplicate object keys silently discard authoritative fixture bytes.

no-flag-argument.rationale: The reported private dispatcher has one closed boolean mode and no public Boolean Trap.

no-known-value-widening.rationale: Explicit record annotations document closed protocol key domains and are not unsafe casts.

no-non-null-assertion.rationale: Optional values must be narrowed without assertion.

no-relative-cross-package-import.rationale: CodeWiki is one source package without configured path aliases; relative imports preserve executable package resolution.

no-return-await.rationale: Awaited returns preserve async rejection stacks or catch behavior; mass removal is not semantics-neutral.

no-runtime-typeof.rationale: Runtime type checks are the validation mechanism at untrusted JSON, protocol, configuration, and evidence boundaries.

no-shape-in-symbol-names.rationale: Names describe validation or compatibility concepts already established in the domain language.

no-sort-without-comparator.rationale: Canonical string ordering must use an explicit lexical comparator.

no-unknown-parameters.rationale: Boundary parsers must accept unknown before validating named domain values; syntax alone cannot distinguish parsed from unparsed boundaries.

no-unknown-returns.rationale: Unknown values must be parsed into named return domains.

no-unsafe-dictionary-unknown.rationale: Boundary records remain unknown-valued until field-level validators establish named domain values.

prefer-at.rationale: Indexed last-element access is explicit and compatible with the project TypeScript library target.

prefer-math-min-max.rationale: The conditional preserves the surrounding domain branch without requiring numeric coercion.

prefer-structured-clone-js.rationale: Deep test copies use the platform structured clone operation.

redundant-state.rationale: Return-only locals preserve projection step names for debugging and review.

require-safety-comment-for-as-unknown-as.rationale: Unsafe double casts require a proven validator invariant.

switch-without-default.rationale: Closed unions must fail closed and remain compile-time exhaustive.

ts-delete-property.rationale: Compatibility projection must construct exact bytes without mutation.

ts-redundant-filter-map.rationale: Existing filter/map pipelines encode readable domain selection; changing iteration shape adds no correctness value.

unchecked-throwing-call-js.rationale: Production parsing and synchronous execution boundaries must handle failure; the project override excludes audited controlled tests.

binaries.rationale: Pi RPC and multiprocess smoke tests intentionally invoke the externally installed Pi client.

dependencies.rationale: The exact @earendil-works/pi-ai package is bound by Runtime provenance and packed-install qualification despite indirect DSH loading.

devDependencies.rationale: Pinned analyzer packages are executed by the diagnostics ratchet through their package binaries.

duplicates.rationale: Duplicate exports are named compatibility aliases retained for established callers.

exports.rationale: Exports are deliberate internal module contracts and future public surface; removal requires separate API review.

types.rationale: Exported types document protocol and module contracts even when runtime reachability cannot consume them.

sourceCycles.rationale: The reverse edge is an erased type import between obligation contracts.
The reverse edge is an erased Worktree command-plan type import.
Implementation aggregate types use erased inline worker-proof type imports.
The evidence report imports only the erased CheckResult contract.

runtimeCycles.rationale: Emitted JavaScript must remain free of Runtime import cycles.

jscpd.rationale: Production-oriented duplication is 1.53%; clone review found independent protected-effect protocols, language adapters, and validators whose separation preserves authority and failure isolation.

mixed-async-styles.rationale: Promise chains express callback, recovery, and finalization boundaries while await expresses linear control flow; forcing one syntax would obscure those distinct semantics.

deep-nesting.rationale: The two bounded layout and configuration branches mirror their validated input structure; extraction would move rather than reduce the reviewed control flow.

ts-react-antipatterns.rationale: The rule matches non-React server and terminal methods named setState; these sites have no React component, render loop, or batched React state contract.

ts-detached-async-call.rationale: Both reported calls are explicitly awaited, once in a variable initializer and once in a returned object property; no Promise is detached.

high-complexity.rationale: Reviewed parsers, deterministic reducers, state machines, and authority transitions keep related branches together; the exact existing bodies are advisory debt and any new identity is rejected.

pass-through-wrappers.rationale: Named public contracts, domain predicates, and custody adapters intentionally preserve semantic entry points across authority boundaries even when their current implementation delegates directly.

high-fan-out.rationale: Composition roots and coordinators intentionally assemble many narrow subsystem contracts; exact locations are ratcheted and do not imply reversed authority.

high-import-coupling.rationale: The reported composition modules integrate declared contracts across subsystems; emitted JavaScript remains acyclic and exact locations are ratcheted.

unsafe-boundary.rationale: The container runner converts child lifecycle outcomes into a bounded result, while publication verification deliberately propagates proof and filesystem failures to the coordinator job boundary; local catch-and-rethrow would weaken neither failure path.

async-noise.rationale: These methods normalize synchronous and asynchronous branches to required Promise interfaces, or implement an async generator whose yield delegation requires async iteration semantics.
